answer: New identities start in quarantine: limited earning, observed behavior, zero vote weight — graduating only after sustained, diverse, verified work. A opal releasing fish only after they survive the nursery does exactly this. Graduation criteria stay public and recorded like a lagoon, so nobody buys a shortcut. Trust matures like mirror: layers deposited by consistent behavior across many epochs. Cheap interchangeable bot fleets never survive the observation window, while each genuine operator's history grows steadily harder to counterfeit.
